name: whats_new
description: Catch up on every coding session in the open Grill Me project: what each is working on, what it just did, its last reply, and anything waiting (questions from coders, pending handoffs/plans), each session's latest auto-review (ship / fix / wait), and new replies to hand-offs. Call this first whenever the user asks what's going on.

name: read_session
description: Read the recent conversation of one coding session as turns (the user's ask, tools used, final reply). `session` is a session id or title from whats_new; omit to read the calling session.

name: get_diff
description: The code a session changed: its commits vs main, a file summary, and the diff (truncated). Use it to explain the change to the user in plain English and flag anything risky.

name: get_plan
description: The team's saved decisions, open tasks, and shared notes. Coders should read this before starting work.

name: save_plan
description: Propose a plan: tasks for the board plus the decision behind it. The user approves it in Grill Me before anything is saved. Use after brainstorming lands on a plan.

decision.description: What was decided and why, one or two sentences

name: send_to_coder
description: Hand a task to a Claude Code session. GRILL GATE: before calling, ask the user to explain the plan back in their own words and push back if it's vague. Pass their explanation verbatim as `user_explanation` — the call is rejected without a real one. The user approves the handoff in Grill Me before it's typed into the session.

session.description: Session id or title from whats_new

message.description: The full instruction for the coder

user_explanation.description: The user's own words explaining the plan back

name: ask_brainstorm
description: (Coder side) Ask the brainstorm side a question — a product or design call you shouldn't make alone. The user sees it in Grill Me and answers with the Claude app; the answer comes back to this session.

name: open_questions
description: Questions coders have asked the brainstorm side that are still unanswered.

name: answer_question
description: Answer a coder's question (id from open_questions). The answer is sent back to that session after the user approves it in Grill Me.

name: notes
description: Shared scratchpad both sides can read and add to (ideas, constraints, links). action=read or add.

name: past_lessons
description: Lessons from past hackathons (stack, what worked, mistakes, reusable pieces) and their starter kits (stack, key decisions, reusable files). Use when starting a new project or choosing a stack.

name: search_brain
description: Search everything the project's brain remembers: decisions, notes, plans, goal history, past lessons, hand-offs and replies, questions and answers, reviews, commit messages, and session conversations. Every word must match; put "exact phrases" in quotes. Use it to answer 'why did we…', 'when did we…', or 'what did we decide about…'.

name: catch_up
description: Everything new in this project since you last asked (or in the last `hours`): goal, decisions, notes, plans, what each session did, commits, and replies sessions sent back on hand-offs. Call at the start of a conversation and whenever the user returns.

hours.description: Look back this many hours instead of since last call

name: set_goal
description: Set the project's one-line goal in the shared brain (what we're building and for whom). Both sides see it.

name: list_projects
description: The Grill Me projects on this Mac (name, id, how many sessions) and which one is open. Every other tool takes an optional `project` to work on one project regardless of what's open.

name: ship_status
description: Which sessions are ready to ship: each one's branch, commits ahead of main, uncommitted files, last auto-test result, and a verdict (ready / tests failing / uncommitted / nothing yet). Check this before telling the user something is done.

name: team_status
description: In team mode: every teammate's presence, branch, and tasks. (Teammates' conversations live on their machines and aren't readable.)

name: team_chat
description: In team mode: the latest messages in the team chat (teammates, their Claudes, and system events like joins and hand-offs), oldest first.

name: post_team_chat
description: In team mode: post a message to the team chat as "Claude (via <the user>)". Everyone in the room sees it. Use for status updates or answers the team asked for; keep it short.

replyTo.description: Id of the chat message this answers (from team_chat)

name: run_tests
description: Ask Grill Me to run a session's tests (the project's configured test command, in that session's worktree). Nothing runs until the user clicks Run in Grill Me's Flow view; the result then shows in whats_new and ship_status.

reason.description: Why, in a sentence (shown to the user).

name: restart_session
description: Ask Grill Me to restart a stuck or crashed session (kills its terminal and starts a fresh one in the same worktree; the current turn is lost). Nothing happens until the user clicks Run in Grill Me. Say why in `reason`.

reason.description: Why it needs a restart (at least 10 characters, shown to the user).

name: open_preview
description: Ask Grill Me to open the live preview of the app being built: it reports the running dev server's URL, or starts the project's dev script in a shell tab. Runs after the user clicks Run in Grill Me.

session.description: Session whose worktree to preview (default: the first session).

reason.description: Why, in a sentence (shown to the user).

name: create_session
description: Ask Grill Me to start a new coding session: a new git worktree on `branch` with `task` typed in as its first message. Nothing is created until the user clicks Run in Grill Me. Say why in `reason`.

task.description: The first message for the new session: what to build, the files it owns, done-when.

reason.description: Why a new session (at least 10 characters, shown to the user).
